question: If you turned a kraken into [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Takoyaki takoyaki], how many servings would you be able to make out of him? Pirate Crew
answer: Well yeah--. Even if you put lots of octopus into each takoyaki as customer service... there'd be 10 million takoyaki made, so with 1 pack of 8 takoyaki... 1 million 250 thousand packs! You can eat him along with 1 million 250 thousand people!! Wait, don't eat your friend!! (shock)
name: Hunting Pirate Crew
